title: Have an agent keep the release current
statement: As a developer, I can have the agents doing the work keep notes, story links and checklist steps up to date, so these records stay complete without someone maintaining them by hand.
overview: Thorough linking is realistic because an agent does it, which is why the links can be required.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `query releases` returns releases, their stories, notes and steps through the standard snapshot and pagination envelope.
`release guide` and the skill's references explain the workflow, including that a step the agent discovers goes on the checklist when it is discovered.
